V. 5.
The courſe of Abia—The Prieſts were divided into twentyfour Courſes, of which that of Abia was the eighth, 1 Chron. xxiv. 10. Each Courſe miniſtered in its Turn, for ſeven Days, from Sabbath to Sabbath. And each Prieſt of the Courſe or Set in waiting, had his Part in the Temple-Service aſſigned him by Lot.
